drop.idOrTitle: Audit A UI-009 Slider thumb pulse animation setup runs despite reduce motion
drop.reason: In `src/core/components/ui/slider.tsx`, the pulse effect returns early when `reduceMotion` is true and cancels the animation in cleanup; this appears already handled.

drop.idOrTitle: Audit B UI-001 Missing Accessibility Roles on Custom Controls
drop.reason: Key interactions already include explicit roles/labels (e.g., `src/features/wind/components/compass/LockButton.tsx` and `src/features/wind/screen.tsx`). `WindDirectionCompass.tsx` appears to have limited interactive surface beyond the lock button.

drop.idOrTitle: Audit B UI-005 Tab Bar Content Overlap Risk (absolute positioning)
drop.reason: `src/core/components/ui/BoldTabBar.tsx` is not absolutely positioned; overlap should be validated per screen/padding patterns rather than assumed from positioning.

reprioritize.idOrTitle: Audit A UI-001 ErrorBoundary button text uses hardcoded color
reprioritize.reason: In `src/components/error-boundary/ErrorBoundary.tsx`, the hardcoded `#fff` is currently overridden by inline `{ color: t.colors.textPrimary }`. The remaining work is semantic cleanup (likely `onBrand`) rather than a blocker.

reprioritize.idOrTitle: Audit A UI-002 Input component missing accessibilityRole and accessibilityLabel
reprioritize.reason: `InputProps` extends `TextInputProps` in `src/core/components/ui/Input.tsx`, so consumers can pass `accessibilityLabel` today. Improvements are defaults/consistency and ensuring call sites provide labels.

reprioritize.idOrTitle: Audit A UI-004 DiagnosticOverlay tabs have insufficient touch targets
reprioritize.reason: `src/components/diagnostics/DiagnosticOverlay.tsx` is a debug overlay; prioritize primary user flows before tooling polish.

reprioritize.idOrTitle: Audit A UI-006 OnboardingFlow uses FlatList instead of FlashList
reprioritize.reason: `src/components/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx` likely renders a small, bounded dataset; FlashList is optional unless measured perf issues exist.

reprioritize.idOrTitle: Audit B UI-004 Hardcoded Colors in Tailwind Config
reprioritize.reason: Single-sourcing colors is valuable, but it’s primarily an architectural consistency task unless it’s already causing theme drift.
